        <title>The cycle C9 does not admit uniform mixing</title>

            <abstract>We study continuous-time quantum walks (CTQWs) on cycles. In particular, we prove that the cycle $C_9$ does not admit uniform mixing at any time via algebraic geometry and Gröbner basis techniques to rule out all cyclic 9-roots.</abstract>
